supersedes_reason: The v4 runner accidentally used token_budget=6 for token_boundary, whose locked fixture intended token_budget=10. Samples of length 7 and 9 were therefore over budget and dropped whole. v4 remains preserved but does not validate the intended all-group token-boundary case. v5 passes budget per case.

contract.fixed_count: Every emitted microbatch contains exactly 4 rows; no group splits. Unbatchable groups are dropped whole, and the exact number of dropped rows is recorded.
contract.token_budget: Every emitted microbatch has at least one sample per each of 2 ranks and <= per-case token budget per rank. A group is emitted wholly exactly once or dropped wholly with row-count metric. Search must find the exact-fit frozen token rollout.

fixed_boundary.required: whole-group accounting; no underfilled fixed batches

fixed_oversize.required: drop size-5 group whole; retain size-4 group

fixed_infeasible_prefix.required: drop size-1 group whole; retain size-4 group

fixed_exact_control.required: retain both groups in one exact-size batch

token_boundary.required: all groups are within per-sample limits; preserve all groups or account for any whole-group drops; no partial rows

token_exact_fit.required: retain all five rows; exact packing [3,3]/[2,2,2]

success_rule: Base violates the complete-group contract on fixed_boundary and token_boundary. Candidate passes all eight cases; each input row is either emitted once or covered by a whole-group drop count; exact fixed sizes and token budgets hold; token_boundary retains all rows; exact-fit group T is retained.
rejection_rule: Any partial or split group, missing unaccounted row, duplicate row, underfilled fixed batch, rank-empty token batch, token-cap violation, rejection of exact-fit T, or drop of valid token_boundary groups fails.

method.execution: AST-extract _balance_by_squared_length and the two production batcher classes from each checkout; stub only IterableDataset/logger.

claim_limits: Finite source-level fixtures only; no full Trainer/optimizer/distributed execution or task-success effect.
A pass is not a general sample-efficiency result; dropped-row rates must be reported.
